description: Key facts a correct lesson on each Programming for Problem Solving topic must state. Every fact was taken from the fetched text of the source page named with it (the quote is checked by `npm run golden:check`). Patterns are case-insensitive regular expressions matched against the lesson text after LaTeX backslashes and braces are removed.
subject: pps

facts.claim: An algorithm is a finite, well-defined set of steps that solves a problem

source.quote: any well-defined set of instructions that when followed terminates after a finite number of steps

facts.claim: A flowchart shows the steps as boxes connected by arrows

source.quote: The flowchart shows the steps as boxes of various kinds, and their order by connecting the boxes with arrows

facts.claim: A compiler translates source code (high-level) into machine/object code

source.quote: translate source code from a high-level programming language to a low-level programming language

facts.claim: An interpreter runs source code by a different mechanism

source.quote: an interpreter provides a similar function as a compiler, but via a different mechanism

facts.claim: Binary search needs a sorted array

source.quote: the array must be sorted first to be able to apply binary search

facts.claim: Compare with the middle element and discard half

source.quote: Binary search compares the target value to the middle element of the array

facts.claim: Runs in logarithmic time, O(log n)

source.quote: Binary search runs in logarithmic time in the worst case

facts.claim: Bubble sort compares neighbours and swaps them if out of order

source.quote: comparing the current element with the one after it, swapping their values if needed

facts.claim: Bubble sort is O(n²)

source.quote: its O(n2) complexity means that its efficiency decreases dramatically on lists of more than a small number of elements

facts.claim: Passes repeat until no swaps are needed

source.quote: These passes through the list are repeated until no swaps have to be performed during a pass

facts.claim: Insertion sort builds the sorted list one item at a time

source.quote: builds the final sorted array (or list) one item at a time by comparisons

facts.claim: A recursive function calls itself

source.quote: allowing a function to call itself from within its own code

facts.claim: A base case stops the recursion

source.quote: they define a stopping condition that terminates the recursion

facts.claim: Without a base case it can cause a stack overflow

source.quote: the recursion may continue indefinitely, leading to non-termination or even stack overflow errors

facts.claim: A pointer stores a memory address

source.quote: a pointer is an object in many programming languages that stores a memory address

facts.claim: Getting the value at that address is dereferencing

source.quote: obtaining the value stored at that location is known as dereferencing the pointer

facts.claim: Each node holds data and a link to the next node

source.quote: each node contains data, and a reference (in other words, a link) to the next node in the sequence

facts.claim: Order is not given by placement in memory

source.quote: a linear collection of data elements whose order is not given by their physical placement in memory

facts.claim: Newton–Raphson follows the tangent line to the next guess

source.quote: approximate the function by its tangent line near the guess, and then take the root of the linear approximation as a next guess

facts.claim: x_{n+1} = x_n − f(x_n)/f′(x_n), repeated until it converges

source.quote: the method can be iterated

facts.claim: Big O describes how running time grows as input size grows

source.quote: characterizes functions according to their growth rates as the variable becomes large

facts.claim: It gives an upper bound

source.quote: only provides an upper bound on the growth rate of the function

facts.claim: malloc allocates a block on the heap

source.quote: the library function malloc is used to allocate a block of memory on the heap

facts.claim: free releases the memory when it is no longer needed

source.quote: the pointer is passed to free which deallocates the memory

facts.claim: Merge sort is a divide-and-conquer algorithm

source.quote: Merge sort is a divide-and-conquer algorithm

facts.claim: O(n log n) comparisons

source.quote: merge sort has an average and worst-case performance of O(n log n) comparisons

facts.claim: A loop executes code repeatedly

source.quote: a loop is a control flow construct that allows code to be executed repeatedly

facts.claim: A loop counter controls the iterations

source.quote: A loop counter is a control variable that controls the iterations of a loop

facts.claim: switch chooses a branch from the value of an expression

source.quote: a switch statement is a selection control flow mechanism that changes execution control based on the value of an expression

facts.claim: In C each case ends with break (else it falls through); default handles the rest

source.quote: each section ends with a keyword (such as break) if that section should not fall through
